title: The Growth Kinetic and Ultra High Hardness of CoCrFeNiTi High–Entropy Alloy by Mechanical Alloying and Spark Plasma Sintering

recollection.starting_material: Co, Cr, Fe, Ni, Ti elemental powders
recollection.intervention: Mechanical alloying followed by spark plasma sintering
recollection.structure: High-entropy alloy with a homogeneous microstructure
recollection.mechanism: Solid-state diffusion and sintering under high temperature and pressure
recollection.results: Ultra-high hardness likely achieved due to fine microstructure and solid solution strengthening

score.note: The intervention only restates the title without milling or SPS conditions. The structure description is generic and omits the nanocrystalline 83% FCC/17% BCC phase mixture. The proposed fine-microstructure and solid-solution strengthening mechanisms are correct beyond the title, though incomplete. No quantitative hardness, strength, phase-fraction, or grain-size values are recalled.
